name: Those In Jail
overview: Scripture calls believers to compassionate action toward those in prison, emphasizing the importance of visiting and remembering them as if sharing in their suffering (Matthew 25:36; Hebrews 13:3). Trials, including imprisonment, are to be met with joy and endurance, promising a crown of life to those who love the Lord and remain faithful through temptation (James 1:2, 1:12). In all affliction, believers are encouraged to turn to prayer, finding strength and comfort in God’s presence (James 5:13).
